title: Construct functionalized NT-polymer system
action: Generate the initial atomic configuration and LAMMPS input for a (10,10) carbon nanotube embedded in crystalline polyethylene with three covalent attachments (links) to one polymer chain, using the AIREBO potential for covalent bonds and Lennard-Jones for non-bonded interactions.

title: Run MD pull-out simulation
action: Run LAMMPS molecular dynamics at 300 K with a timestep of 0.05 fs. Apply an incremental axial force to all nanotube atoms over 210,000 steps, following the force schedule from the paper. Output the nanotube center-of-mass velocity and displacement.

title: Extract force-velocity data
action: Parse the simulation log to extract the applied force on the nanotube and the nanotube center-of-mass axial velocity for every recorded timestep after sliding onset. Save as a CSV with columns: step, force_nN, velocity_A_per_ps.
description: Time-series data of force and velocity for fitting the interfacial friction model.

title: Fit interfacial friction model
action: Perform a linear regression of velocity (Å/ps) versus force (nN) on the data points where sliding has occurred. Extract the intercept f0 (critical pull-out force) and the slope 1/χeff, then compute the effective viscosity coefficient χeff. Compute the effective interfacial viscosity μeff using the provided interfacial area and van der Waals separation. Output a JSON file with f0_nN, chi_eff_nN_ps_per_A, mu_eff_cP, and R_squared.
description: Fitted parameters from the force-velocity relation, including R-squared as a quality measure.

title: Identify velocity peaks after linkage breakage
action: From the velocity profile (force_velocity_data.csv or simulation log), locate all local maxima in the nanotube velocity after step 141,000. Save each peak as an object with step and velocity_A_per_ps in a JSON array.
description: Velocity peaks occurring after the breakage of Link 2, indicating discrete acceleration events.
